name: Groovy
note: Dynamic scripting language for the JVM, close to a Java superset
typeSystem: Dynamic by default, like a scripting language for the JVM, with an optional static type checker and static compilation mode (@TypeChecked, @CompileStatic) that gives Java-like performance and earlier error detection when opted into.
runtime: Groovy source compiles to JVM bytecode and runs on the standard JVM JIT. Dynamic Groovy uses runtime dispatch, while @CompileStatic enables compile-time type checking and statically resolved dispatch.

runtimes.name: JVM (HotSpot)
runtimes.role: Groovy compiles to ordinary JVM bytecode, benefiting from HotSpot's JIT like any other JVM language.

compilers.name: groovyc
compilers.role: Compiles Groovy source to JVM bytecode, either dynamically dispatched or statically typed depending on annotations.

concurrencyModel: Inherits the full java.util.concurrent toolkit from the JVM, plus GPars, a library adding actors, dataflow, and CSP-style concurrency abstractions on top.
